description: Run any indicator in the catalogue. Returns EVERY output series it has — Donchian gives three bands, MACD gives line, signal and histogram — each reduced, plus the indicator's own conventional levels so the reading can be interpreted against its actual scale. Pass a symbol to load and compute in one call, or a handle to reuse data. The forming bar is excluded unless you ask for it.

params.description: Defaults are used for anything omitted.

plot.description: One output only. Usually omit: the others give the reading meaning.

ref.description: Reuse a handle from market_candles instead of loading.

name: indicator_compute
